nodes.name: Webhook - Fireflies Meeting Ended
nodes.notes: SETUP: In Fireflies.ai → Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook URL → select 'Transcription complete' event. Your webhook URL will be shown after importing this workflow.

nodes.name: Claude AI - Extract Action Items
nodes.notes: SETUP: Create an HTTP Header Auth credential named 'Anthropic API' with your Anthropic API key as the value.

nodes.name: Create Trello Cards
nodes.notes: SETUP: 1) Connect your Trello account in credentials. 2) Replace YOUR_TRELLO_LIST_ID with the ID of your target list (e.g., 'Action Items' list). Find list ID by opening a Trello card URL.

nodes.name: Save to Google Drive
nodes.notes: SETUP: 1) Connect your Google account in credentials. 2) Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID with the folder ID from your Google Drive URL (the long string after /folders/ in the URL). 3) 'Convert to Google Document' is enabled so it becomes a native Google Doc.
